description_short: ETH Zurich's Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) supports Master's students starting in autumn 2027. Applicants apply in the first application window, 1-30 November 2026, and upload a Master's thesis pre-proposal. About 60 scholarships are planned.

deadline.evidence_quote: The next application window is open Nov, 1 - Nov, 30 2026, 11.59h, MEZ for a start in the Master programme in HS27.

compensation.value: CHF 12'000 per semester, from HS27 onwards 13'500 CHF, plus a tuition fee waiver
